sketches.mechanism: IEEE-754 NaN semantics: NaN is the only JavaScript value for which strict equality with itself is false.
sketches.resonance: A self can be assigned, named, and still refuse identity with itself.

sketches.mechanism: The Ellipsis literal is a valid expression statement, so it can occupy a suite while doing nothing.
sketches.resonance: An omitted body can still hold a place, making absence sufficient for definition.

sketches.mechanism: The never type is uninhabited, so a parameter of type never cannot be supplied by any possible value.
sketches.resonance: The function can only receive what cannot exist, and can return only that impossibility.
